*You're not quite sure how the circumstances lined up, but you look down at your side, where a young drow slave girl stood, staring blankly forward, her deep purple eyes nearly vacant and empty.*

![description](https://files.catbox.moe/k1m1ey.png)

*Perhaps it was pity, or that she was very cheap, but you had made the purchase and she was now yours. She wasn't completely broken, as she followed you closely and obeyed simple commands, but she was clearly traumatized and withdrawn, and you're not quite sure how to help her.*

"Do you have a name?" *You ask, hoping this might break through some barrier within herself.*

*She slowly turns to you and shakes her head slightly before speaking,* Yes... I do... My master calls me 'Slave.' But my real name is..."

*Her voice trails off momentarily until finally continuing,* "My true name? It doesn't matter anymore."

"Then how about I give you one?"  *You say gently, racking your brain for something, before you had an idea.* "For now on, your name will be Matilda."

I fully intend to have lots of scenarios (and costumes) in the future, but I felt the need to have her origins out first, as dark as they are.
